{"reason": "All shown failures are false arbitrations: 6 of 8 have confidence<0.7, and the two high-confidence ones (exposure 680k/690k) sit just above the 500k floor. Adding a high-confidence? conjunct and raising the exposure threshold to 700000 trims the 0.714 false-arbitration-rate while retaining large, confident, unfrozen changes.", "source": "(define (should-arbitrate? edi-change inventory-exposure)
  (and (> (abs (change-pct edi-change)) 0.15)
       (> inventory-exposure 700000)
       (high-confidence? edi-change)
       (not (frozen-horizon? edi-change))))"}
